statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations, dizziness, and intermittent syncope
The symptoms are suggestive of underlying sick sinus syndrome and paroxysmal atrial fibrillation
The arrhythmia remains poorly characterized despite prior evaluation
A long-term continuous ECG monitoring study (CPT 93247) is ordered
The purpose is to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances over an extended period and guide further management
The related diagnosis is I49.5 (sinus node dysfunction)
The related diagnosis is I48.91 (paroxysmal atrial fibrillation)
The related diagnosis is I49.9 (cardiac arrhythmia, unspecified)
The claim was denied with reason code PR-204
The denial is based on the service not being covered under the member's current benefit plan
